candidate_description: When public/native Stage configuration and the request both omit teacache_thresh, native I2V automatically uses the existing bounded TeaCache residual policy at 0.25. Explicit request or Stage values including zero retain precedence. T2V and the legacy direct-engine constructor remain uncached. No CUDA kernel, solver, precision, frame, resolution, sampling, or public schema changes.
schedule: five repetitions; seeded arm order per repetition; fresh native Wan process per arm block; one excluded warmup per shape before its measured request; fixed wide,tall,square order within arm
cold_prefix_policy: model load and every warmup are retained separately and excluded from warm medians/p95; outliers remain in all statistics
source_policy: exact frozen real public FLUX.2 wide/tall/square PNG bytes and evaluation RGB from the bound baseline profile
client_policy: identical public POST /v1/visual/render requests with teacache_thresh omitted in both arms; no manual modality or frame-budget control
cancellation_protocol: one real non-streaming click-to-animate disconnect per arm, one second after observed native submit; record native abort terminal, client/health settlement, late native records and zero public media; immediate same-source retry must match that arm's exact MP4 hash. The route exposes no request id, so /abort ACK is NOT_APPLICABLE rather than fabricated.

ns01_protocol.user_prompt: Use one labeled still and one short animation to explain black-hole accretion disks and gravitational lensing simply, in plain prose without headings or bullets.
ns01_protocol.visual_policy: existing narrative auto with i2v_chain; no hand-authored image/video directive in the user prompt
ns01_protocol.language_boundary: English semantic NS-01 only; the exact Chinese rubric prompt was attempted separately and failed in native TTS, so no exact Chinese golden-case PASS is claimed
ns01_protocol.paired_quality_gates: same exact first-frame RGB, SSIM >=0.90, all-frame PSNR >=24 dB, temporal-motion ratio [0.5,1.5], exact per-run source/anchor binding, clean text/TTS and one terminal
ns01_protocol.reporting: every cold/process-separated observation is retained; unrelated TTFT/TTFA/image failures remain visible and do not become a full NS PASS

analysis: report all raw latencies, median/p95/IQR/MAD, per-shape paired deltas, all quality values, cancellation timing, failures and outliers; no post-observation threshold or variant changes
promotion_rule: PROMOTED only when all NS-02 quality, speed, video-threshold, cancellation and recovery gates pass and the separate NS-01 paired controls do not regress. Otherwise NOT_PROMOTED and remove the candidate from the final runtime. Numeric fidelity is not perceptual judging.
